description: A scripted sequence of claim entries through every row of the claim rules (wire 6.8, spec 10.2), run on the prototype Pubky Switch. Every write is one batch with one claim operation; after a successful write the expected state is GET /claims/{claim_key} as app A sees it (404 once a tombstone or a failed claim is deleted, when the service clock reaches its pinned deadline plus the 30-day reconciliation window). Failed writes show the error status, code and current. The account is identity (its key from the seed label identity_seed_label), enrolled at start_time and given its identity.json (version 1, generation 1, data epoch 1, listing apps A to E with the hashes of their certs, and naming the service key the switch drew at random, so it isn't given here); each app then registered, in one batch with batch ID seed claims/register/<name>, its registered_record and registered_receive_key, under its cert. A noop_batch step (wire 6.4) sends request_body, a batch of one unchanged app.put of the record the app registered, conditioned on claim O11's step when condition_step is set, with cursor.set to cursor_position when cursor is true; its expect is the status and the number of proofs, or the error. An app_put step (wire 6.2) sends request_body, a batch of one app.put of record: with variant held the record the app registered, with variant equal_time that record with its updated_at and another label, signed by the app; its expect is the status and the number of proofs, or the error. The service clock starts at start_time and moves only with advance steps.

quota.description: Wire 9.3: the per-app claim limits, on a switch of its own set up as the main sequence's (the same identity, apps and registrations) but with max_claims 12 and open_attempts_per_app 2, so one app's claims, live and tombstones, hold at most 3 (claim_share_percent 25). Each write is one batch with one claim entry; after a successful write the expected state is GET /claims/{claim_key} as the writer sees it, and a refused one shows the error. Batch ID seeds are claims/quota/batch/<n - 1>.

steps.note: A's first claim: ATTEMPTING(A, q1)
A's second claim: A holds 2 attempts open
a third open attempt of A: 429 quota_exceeded, open_attempts
A finishes q1: a tombstone, 1 attempt open
A's third claim, its share of 12 * 25 / 100
A finishes q2: 1 attempt open
a fourth claim created by A: 429 quota_exceeded, claim_share
the same claim created by B, whose share has room
FREE + attempt: ATTEMPTING(A, a1)
a second wallet while a1 is open: conflict
basis owner from another app: conflict
stale expected_step: conflict
owner reports done: SETTLED, compacted to a tombstone
SETTLED rejects attempt
SETTLED rejects unknown
a repeated done changes nothing: conflict
attempt a1
owner reports failed: FREE
attempt b1
b1 done: tombstone
evidence for the failed a1, on the tombstone: duplicate
attempt a1 with orphan_after 60 s
unknown before a1 is orphaned: conflict
a1 is orphaned: orphan_after has passed
user-confirmed unknown: FREE
attempt after an unknown one: possibly_duplicate
owner reports b1 failed: FREE
failed on a1 from another app while its owner is current: conflict
reconcile needs an open attempt: conflict
evidence settles the unknown a1: tombstone
attempt c1
attempt d1
attempt c2
reconcile before c1 is orphaned: conflict
failed from another app while the owner is current: conflict
c1 is orphaned: its owner isn't current
user-confirmed reconcile: SETTLED, tombstone
user-confirmed unknown: FREE
failed on an unknown attempt whose owner isn't current
attempt after a failure B wrote for another app's attempt: possibly_duplicate
failed on an open, orphaned attempt whose owner isn't current: FREE
a revoked app writes nothing
attempt with a deadline 600 s after the start
done: tombstone keeping the deadline
the service clock reached the deadline: the tombstone stays for the 30-day reconciliation window
a re-sent copy is refused by its deadline
attempt with a deadline: it pins the claim's deadline
the owner fails it: FREE
an attempt naming another deadline: conflict
an attempt without a deadline: conflict, the pin stands
an attempt naming the pinned deadline: ATTEMPTING(B, b1)
attempt without orphan_after
done without a basis
basis evidence without evidence_ref
only an attempt carries a deadline
an app without claims.write
nothing was stored
attempt with a deadline 1200 s after the start
the owner fails it: FREE, its only attempt failed
the service clock reached the deadline: the failed claim stays for the 30-day reconciliation window
a late receipt within the window: done on the failed attempt, SETTLED, a tombstone
a failing condition without cursor.set: a no-op, answered before the conditions
the same with cursor.set: checked in full, 409 conflict, the cursor stays
a condition that holds, with cursor.set: the cursor moves, no proof, no chain item
the revoked app's app.put of its held record with cursor.set: 403 not_current
1 s before O10's deadline plus 30 days: the tombstone is kept
O7's deadline plus 30 days has passed: the tombstone is deleted
the service clock reached O10's deadline plus 30 days: deleted
the record the switch holds, byte for byte: a no-op, no proof
a record with the held record's updated_at and another label: 409 conflict, the held record in current
